nodes.description: Mapping(address=>bool) whitelist controlling who may transfer while the token is locked.
Boolean lock flag; when true only the owner or whitelisted addresses may transfer.
_owner address inherited from Ownable, the privileged account for onlyOwner functions.
UniMex constructor, initializes ERC20 metadata and sets locked = true.
onlyOwner function that sets locked = false, disabling transfer restrictions.
onlyOwner function that sets locked = true, re-enabling transfer restrictions.
onlyOwner function that sets whitelist[_user] = true.
onlyOwner function that sets whitelist[_user] = false.
onlyOwner function that mints new tokens to an arbitrary address via _mint.
Overridden ERC20 transfer; when locked requires msg.sender to be owner or whitelisted.
Overridden ERC20 transferFrom; when locked requires the 'from' address to be owner or whitelisted.
Ownable modifier requiring _owner == _msgSender(), the sole access-control gate for privileged functions.
msg.sender, externally controlled caller used in lock/whitelist access checks.
ERC20 _mint invocation that increases total supply and credits a balance.
_transfer balance mutation executed through super.transfer / super.transferFrom under the lock gate.
Ownable owner() view returning the privileged _owner address used in transfer guards.
ERC20 internal _transfer that updates sender and recipient balances and emits Transfer.
Parameter _user of addToWhitelist / removeFromWhitelist identifying the whitelisted address.
Parameter _to of mint(), the recipient of newly minted tokens.
Parameter _amount of mint(), the quantity of tokens created.
Parameter 'to' of transfer(), destination of the token transfer.
Parameter 'amount' of transfer(), quantity of tokens moved.
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom(), the account checked against owner/whitelist when locked.
Parameter 'to' of transferFrom(), destination of the allowance-based transfer.
Parameter 'amount' of transferFrom(), quantity of tokens moved.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against owner() and whitelist in transfer() when locked, gating the call.
msg.sender determines authorization for the transferFrom allowance spend when locked.
whitelist[msg.sender] is read as the access-control predicate in transfer().
onlyOwner modifier guards unlock() and can disable the transfer lock.
onlyOwner modifier guards lock().
onlyOwner modifier guards addToWhitelist().
onlyOwner modifier guards removeFromWhitelist().
onlyOwner modifier guards mint(), preventing arbitrary supply inflation.
_owner state variable is the value compared to _msgSender() inside onlyOwner.
owner() result is used in the transfer() authorization check.
whitelist mapping is read to authorize transfer() when the contract is locked.
whitelist mapping is read to authorize transferFrom() when the contract is locked.
locked boolean is read to decide whether the transfer restriction applies.
locked boolean is read to decide whether the transferFrom restriction applies.
unlock() writes locked = false, removing transfer restrictions.
lock() writes locked = true, restoring transfer restrictions.
addToWhitelist() writes whitelist[_user] = true, granting transfer rights.
removeFromWhitelist() writes whitelist[_user] = false, revoking transfer rights.
constructor initializes locked = true.
mint() invokes the internal _mint operation to create tokens.
mint recipient _to flows into _mint(account, amount).
mint amount _amount flows into _mint and increases total supply.
transfer() delegates to super.transfer which performs the balance mutation.
transferFrom() delegates to super.transferFrom which performs the balance mutation.
ERC20 _transfer (via super.transfer) is invoked as an internal call from transfer().
ERC20 _transfer (via super.transferFrom) is invoked as an internal call from transferFrom().
transfer destination 'to' flows into the transfer path.
transfer amount flows into the transfer path and balance arithmetic.
transferFrom 'from' flows into the lock/whitelist authorization check.
transferFrom 'to' flows into the transfer path.
transferFrom amount flows into the allowance and balance arithmetic.
_user parameter is written into whitelist within addToWhitelist.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _user only exists to index the whitelist mapping inside addToWhitelist/removeFromWhitelist, so it collapses into that function node.
Parameter _to of mint() merely forwards to _mint and has no independent semantics, so it merges into the mint function node.
Parameter _amount of mint() directly drives the _mint unsafe operation's supply increase, so it merges into that unsafe_operation node.
Parameter 'to' of transfer() is only consumed by the overridden transfer function, so it merges into that function node.
Parameter 'amount' of transfer() is only consumed by the overridden transfer function, so it merges into that function node.
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom() participates only in the transferFrom lock/whitelist check, so it merges into that function node.
Parameter 'to' of transferFrom() is only consumed by the overridden transferFrom function, so it merges into that function node.
Parameter 'amount' of transferFrom() is only consumed by the overridden transferFrom function, so it merges into that function node.
